After careful review, we have reached a decision regarding your submission to Ultima Computing : Jurnal Sistem Komputer, titled "Design and Development of an Automated Gymnastics Movement Evaluation Device".

Your article requires REVISION to be formally accepted and published in our Journal. You are asked to submit a revised full manuscript, according to the comments from reviewers. Our Editorial Team will verify whether the revised version of the manuscript addresses all points raised by the reviewers' comments.

Please upload the revised version to the Revision Section on your submission page within 2 weeks using Word (.doc/.docx) format.

Editor Notes :
-------------------------------------

Please read the reviewers' comments carefully.
 

Thank you for your cooperation
--
